prose: Fortune reports that Catalyst, an AI retail trading agent startup, raised a $30 million seed led by Sequoia, and says a pilot generated hundreds of millions of dollars in trading volume over two weeks. The excerpt covers the founders' backstory; fuller details were not available.
Basis: Techmeme excerpt. Performance and customer numbers are the company's claims.
highlights: Catalyst raises $30M seed led by Sequoia
Claims hundreds of millions in pilot trading volume in two weeks
